text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
These results far exceed my expectations! 
Plus, with this many plushies, I could use 
them as experimental material too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
For instance, if we load an AI with each 
Umamusume's traits, install a drive 
mechanism, and run a tabletop mock race, 
it could serve as a simulation for the 
actual race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're feeling sympathy for an inanimate 
object?! You truly are a fascinating 
guinea pig, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's put the plushie on display! In 
exchange, allow me to thoroughly study the 
fluctuations in your emotions!
